dedupe_keys.name: examon hpc energy and performance monitoring

description: ExaMon is software for monitoring the performance and energy use of high-performance computing servers, published by contributors associated with ETH Zurich and the University of Bologna. Its repository provides server components, metric publishers, dashboards and configuration documentation. The documented Docker Compose setup combines an MQTT broker, database connector, Grafana, KairosDB and Cassandra; a REST service exposes stored observations. Public source files use MIT terms, while bundled components retain their separate licences. The software is free to access but requires users to provide computing and storage resources. It has no independent geographic coverage or sampling interval: deployment sites, plugins and sensors determine those properties. ExaMon can gather and prepare calibration observations for data-centre capacity and digital-twin studies, relating directly to data-cineca-marconi-examon-telemetry and in purpose to platform-exadigit. A caveat is that the example publisher generates random metrics for testing, not measured facility data. Production use needs suitable sensor plugins and configuration, and this review did not install or operate the stack.
